summary: BigBear.ai Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 31, 2026, reporting the entry into an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC as sales agent. Under the agreement, the company may sell up to 100,000,000 shares of its common stock through an at-the-market offering, pursuant to its existing Form S-3 registration statement and a prospectus supplement dated July 31, 2026. Jefferies will receive compensation up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from ATM sales, though no immediate offering is guaranteed.
